environment.description: Lambda function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/KafkaProducerRole with condition StringEquals aws:PrincipalOrgID=o-abc123def4. Callers must sign requests with SigV4 using credentials from the authorized role. The IAM role KafkaProducerRole has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/ServiceBoundary) that further restricts invocation to source VPC endpoint vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f. CloudTrail data events are enabled for the function URL with a metric filter alerting on >5 invocations per minute from any single principal. The function URL has no CORS configuration (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header returned), preventing browser-based cross-origin exploitation.
